string.name: help
string.comment: Overflow menu item on the app list screen, and toolbar button in the Shader/Soundbank file manager. Opens the Help dialog. Short noun.

string.name: action_settings
string.comment: Overflow menu item 'Settings' on the app list, in the per-app config and in the key mapper, and a neutral button in dialogs. Opens the Settings screen or the per-app config. Keep it a short noun.

string.name: PREF_SCALE_RATIO
string.comment: Static label to the left of the numeric scaling field in the Screen card. Percent sign is part of the label; the field holds a number such as 100.

string.name: PREF_SCALE_TO_FIT
string.comment: Old scale-mode option from earlier versions, replaced by the Scale type dropdown (pref_screen_scale_type_fit). Not shown in the current UI.

string.name: PREF_KEEP_ASPECT_RATIO
string.comment: Checkbox label in the Screen card. Keeps the original screen proportions when the emulated screen is scaled to the device.

string.name: PREF_FILTER
string.comment: Switch label in the Screen card. Enables texture filtering (smoothing) of the scaled emulated screen; disabling it can speed up slow games.

string.name: PREF_IMMEDIATE
string.comment: Switch label in the Screen card: renders each frame immediately instead of buffering, which fixes image flickering in some games. The Help dialog refers to this option by name.

string.name: PREF_SHOW_FPS
string.comment: Switch label in the Screen card. Draws a frame-rate counter over the emulated screen.

string.name: PREF_FORCE_FULLSCREEN
string.comment: Switch label in the Screen card. Hides the system status and navigation bars while the MIDlet runs.

string.name: PREF_LIMIT_FPS
string.comment: Label to the left of the numeric FPS limit field in the Screen card, and an in-game menu item that opens the same setting as a dialog. Leave room for the value field.

string.name: PREF_FONT_OPTIONS
string.comment: Title of the second card on the per-app config screen, holding emulated font sizes, presets and anti-aliasing.

string.name: PREF_WIDTH
string.comment: Hint inside the numeric field for the emulated screen width in pixels. Disappears once the field has a value; single word.

string.name: PREF_HEIGHT
string.comment: Hint inside the numeric field for the emulated screen height in pixels. Disappears once the field has a value; single word.
